data.text: Discovery for the report catalogue: kadence already answers 6 of Jira's 13 board reports (control chart, CFD, resolution time, average age, created-vs-resolved, burndown) and structurally cannot answer 2 (deployment frequency, DevOps cycle time - both need CI events over the network). The real gaps are burnup, time-in-status and epic rollup. The bigger finding is discoverability, not coverage: burndown, velocity and workload are folds that already exist but live under 'sprint' and 'stats', so 'kadence report' is not the catalogue it looks like.
